description: Drafts a perpetual order as a link to Angler's trading screen with the order panel filled in (asset, long or short, size in USD, market or limit, leverage, take profit, stop loss, venue). It places nothing: the user opens the link, reviews the order and presses the button themselves. Use it to hand over a trade the user asked for.

leverage.description: Optional; capped by the market's maximum on the site.

size_usd.description: Position size in USD (notional, not margin).

symbol.description: Asset ticker, e.g. BTC, ETH, NVDA.

venue.description: Optional venue id (e.g. hyperliquid, lighter, aster); unset lets Angler route it.

name: draft_order
title: Draft a perp order
